# Consolidate repr_print/deep_copy into dataclass.cc with recursive hash/compare APIs and auto-generated __ffi_init__

## TL;DR
- `deep_copy.cc` and `repr_print.cc` merged into `src/ffi/extra/dataclass.cc` backed by a shared `ObjectGraphDFS<Derived, FrameT, ResultT>` CRTP iterative DFS engine, eliminating duplicated cycle/DAG graph-walking logic.
- New public C++ APIs in `include/tvm/ffi/extra/dataclass.h`: `RecursiveHash`, `RecursiveEq`, `RecursiveLt/Le/Gt/Ge` — reflection-driven recursive comparisons with per-field opt-out via new `refl::compare(false)` / `refl::hash(false)` traits and 4 new C ABI field flag bits.
- `ObjectDef<Class>` destructor now auto-generates `__ffi_init__` from reflection metadata when no explicit `refl::init<Args...>` is supplied; new `include/tvm/ffi/reflection/init.h` contains `MakeInit` / `RegisterAutoInit`.

## Key Exports

```python
# --- include/tvm/ffi/extra/dataclass.h ---

def DeepCopy(value: Any) -> Any: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS (DeepCopyTraversal), ForEachFieldInfo, FieldGetter/FieldSetter
    # Invariant: primitive/string/Shape passed through as-is; Objects must have copy support

def ReprPrint(value: Any) -> String: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS (ReprTraversal), TypeAttrColumn(kRepr)
    # Invariant: same contract as before; now backed by unified DFS engine

def RecursiveHash(value: Any) -> int64_t: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS (HashTraversal), kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskHashOff
    # Invariant: consistent with RecursiveEq — RecursiveEq(a,b) => RecursiveHash(a)==RecursiveHash(b)

def RecursiveEq(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS (CompareTraversal), kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskCompareOff
    # Invariant: identity short-circuit for same pointer; cycle-safe via DFS state tracking

def RecursiveLt(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
def RecursiveLe(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
def RecursiveGt(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
def RecursiveGe(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
    # All share the same CompareTraversal; registered as "ffi.RecursiveLt/Le/Gt/Ge"

# --- CRTP engine (src/ffi/extra/dataclass.cc, internal) ---

class FrameBase:
    """Single-frame state for iterative DFS traversal."""
    kind: Literal["kSequence", "kMap", "kObject"]
    type_index: int32_t
    obj: const Object*
    children: List[Any]
    field_infos: List[TVMFFIFieldInfo*]  # kObject only
    child_idx: int
    container_size: int

class ObjectGraphDFS(Generic[Derived, FrameT, ResultT]):
    """CRTP iterative DFS engine shared by all four dataclass operations."""
    stack_: List[FrameT]

    def RunLoop(self) -> ResultT:
        """Iterative post-order DFS. Calls Derived::TryVisitChild, FeedChild, FinalizeFrame."""
        # Invariant: max stack depth = 1<<20 (raises ValueError if exceeded)
        # Interacts with: EnumerateChildren (Array/List/Map/Dict/Object dispatch)
        # Extension: subclass and implement TryVisitChild/FeedChild/FinalizeFrame/GetFieldSkipMask

    def EnumerateChildren(self, frame: FrameBase, value: Any, obj: Object*, ti: int32_t) -> None:
        """Dispatch container type; populate frame.children and frame.field_infos."""
        # Array/List -> kSequence, Map/Dict -> kMap, reflected Object -> kObject
        # kObject: calls ForEachFieldInfo, skipping fields with GetFieldSkipMask() bits set

    def GetFieldSkipMask(self) -> uint32_t:
        """Returns bitmask of field flags to skip (e.g. CompareOff, HashOff).
        # Default: 0 (skip nothing). Derived classes override for ReprOff, CompareOff, HashOff.
        """

# --- include/tvm/ffi/reflection/init.h ---

def MakeInit(type_index: int32_t) -> Function:
    """Build a packed __ffi_init__ from reflection metadata for the given type.
    # Interacts with: TVMFFIGetTypeInfo, ForEachFieldInfo, TVMFFIObjectCreator
    # Invariant: type must have metadata.creator != nullptr
    # Supports: positional args (required before optional), kw_only fields, KWARGS sentinel
    """

def RegisterAutoInit(type_index: int32_t) -> None:
    """Call MakeInit and register result as __ffi_init__ method with auto_init:true metadata."""
    # Interacts with: TVMFFITypeRegisterMethod, type_attr.kInit ("__ffi_init__")

# --- New reflection traits in include/tvm/ffi/reflection/registry.h ---

class repr(InfoTrait):
    """Lowercase alias for old Repr. refl::repr(false) excludes field from repr."""
    # OLD: refl::Repr(false) -> NEW: refl::repr(false)
    # Interacts with: kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskReprOff (1<<6)

class compare(InfoTrait):
    """refl::compare(false) excludes field from RecursiveEq/Lt/etc."""
    def Apply(self, info: TVMFFIFieldInfo) -> None:
        # Sets kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskCompareOff (1<<7)

class hash(InfoTrait):
    """refl::hash(false) excludes field from RecursiveHash."""
    def Apply(self, info: TVMFFIFieldInfo) -> None:
        # Sets kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskHashOff (1<<8)

class kw_only(InfoTrait):
    """refl::kw_only(true) marks field as keyword-only in auto-generated __ffi_init__."""
    def Apply(self, info: TVMFFIFieldInfo) -> None:
        # Sets kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskKwOnly (1<<10)

class default_value(DefaultValue):
    """Lowercase alias for DefaultValue."""
    ...

class default_factory(DefaultFactory):
    """Lowercase alias for DefaultFactory."""
    ...

# init<> zero-args specialization now doubles as InfoTrait:
class init_zero_args(InfoTrait):  # init<> specialization
    """init(false) per-field: excludes field from auto-generated init.
    init(false) as ObjectDef ctor arg: suppresses auto-init entirely.
    init<>() passed to ObjectDef.def(): registers zero-arg constructor (existing).
    """
    def Apply(self, info: TVMFFIFieldInfo) -> None:
        # Sets kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskInitOff (1<<9)

# CTAD guide: init(bool) deduces to init<>
# Example: refl::init(false)  ->  init<>(false)

# --- New C ABI field flag bits in include/tvm/ffi/c_api.h ---
# kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskCompareOff = 1 << 7  (field excluded from RecursiveEq/compare)
# kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskHashOff    = 1 << 8  (field excluded from RecursiveHash)
# kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskInitOff    = 1 << 9  (field excluded from auto __ffi_init__)
# kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskKwOnly     = 1 << 10 (field is keyword-only in auto __ffi_init__)

# --- New TypeAttr names in type_attr namespace ---
# type_attr.kHash    = "__ffi_hash__"    (custom recursive hash hook)
# type_attr.kEq      = "__ffi_eq__"      (custom recursive equality hook)
# type_attr.kCompare = "__ffi_compare__" (custom three-way comparison hook)

# --- Sentinel objects in src/ffi/object.cc ---
# ffi.GetInvalidObject -> ObjectRef (MISSING sentinel, identity-tested for Map.get)
# ffi.GetKwargsObject  -> ObjectRef (KWARGS sentinel, marks start of kw args in packed call)
```

## Impact
- API: `refl::Repr` renamed to `refl::repr` (lowercase). Downstream: `refl::Repr(false)` → `refl::repr(false)`. `include/tvm/ffi/extra/deep_copy.h` removed from public headers (was `deep_copy.h`; moved to `src/ffi/object_internal.h` as internal `GetMissingObject`/`GetKwargsObject` declarations). `test_repr.py` renamed to `test_dataclass_repr.py`.
- Behavioral: `ObjectDef<Class>` destructor auto-generates `__ffi_init__` when no explicit `refl::init<Args...>` was registered. `AccessStepObj` and `AccessPathObj` registrations updated to `refl::init(false)` to suppress auto-init for internal types. Test objects (`TestCxxClassBase`, `TestCxxClassDerived`, etc.) lose explicit constructors — fields become default-initialized (all zeros/empty).
- Flags/config: 4 new C ABI enum values in `TVMFFIFieldFlagBitMask`: `CompareOff(1<<7)`, `HashOff(1<<8)`, `InitOff(1<<9)`, `KwOnly(1<<10)`.
- Data formats/schemas: `auto_init: true` metadata JSON key injected in auto-generated `__ffi_init__` method info. New `type_attr` constants `kHash`, `kEq`, `kCompare` for future custom hook registration.

## Design Elements
Design elements this commit consumes:
- `0006-reflection` — `ObjectDef<T>`, `ForEachFieldInfo`, `InfoTrait`, `AttachFieldFlag`, `DefaultValue`, `TVMFFIFieldInfo.flags`, `TVMFFITypeMetadata.creator`, `type_attr.kInit`
- `0001-c-abi` — `TVMFFIFieldFlagBitMask` enum (extended), `TVMFFIFieldInfo`, `TVMFFIGetTypeInfo`, `TVMFFITypeRegisterMethod`
- `0030-repr-print` — `ReprPrinter` class (replaced by `ObjectGraphDFS<ReprTraversal>`)
- `0002-object-system` — `make_object<T>`, `ObjectPtr`, `UnsafeInit`, `ObjectUnsafe`
- `0009-structural-eq-hash` — `StructuralEqual`/`StructuralHash` (parallel but distinct system — RecursiveHash/Eq are a new simpler API)
- `0026-overload-system` — `OverloadObjectDef::def(init<>)` patched to set `has_explicit_init_`

Design elements this commit produces:
- New `ObjectGraphDFS<Derived, FrameT, ResultT>` CRTP engine (in `src/ffi/extra/dataclass.cc`, internal)
- New `dataclass.h` public API: `DeepCopy`, `ReprPrint`, `RecursiveHash`, `RecursiveEq/Lt/Le/Gt/Ge`
- New `reflection/init.h`: `MakeInit`, `RegisterAutoInit` — auto-generated `__ffi_init__` from reflection metadata
- Auto-init behavior baked into `ObjectDef<Class>` destructor (in `registry.h`)
- New reflection traits: `refl::repr`, `refl::compare`, `refl::hash`, `refl::kw_only`, `refl::init(bool)`, `refl::default_`, `refl::default_factory`
- KWARGS calling convention: `ffi.GetKwargsObject` sentinel + key/value positional encoding after sentinel position
- MISSING sentinel: `ffi.GetInvalidObject` (relocated from `deep_copy.cc` area to `object.cc`)

## Usage Examples

### C++ type with auto-generated __ffi_init__ and field trait opt-outs
**Context**: Defining an mutable Object that uses auto-init with kw_only and hash/compare opt-outs.

```cpp
// C++ definition:
class MyNodeObj : public Object {
 public:
  int64_t value;           // init=True, positional
  int64_t cache_key = -1;  // init=False (excluded from init), compare=False, hash=False
  String tag;              // init=True, kw_only

  static constexpr bool _type_mutable = true;
  TVM_FFI_DECLARE_OBJECT_INFO("mylib.MyNode", MyNodeObj, Object);
};

// Registration — no explicit refl::init<> needed; ObjectDef destructor auto-generates __ffi_init__
TVM_FFI_STATIC_INIT_BLOCK({
  namespace refl = tvm::ffi::reflection;
  refl::ObjectDef<MyNodeObj>()
      .def_rw("value",     &MyNodeObj::value)
      .def_rw("cache_key", &MyNodeObj::cache_key,
              refl::init(false),         // excluded from __ffi_init__
              refl::compare(false),      // excluded from RecursiveEq
              refl::hash(false),         // excluded from RecursiveHash
              refl::default_value(-1))
      .def_rw("tag",       &MyNodeObj::tag, refl::kw_only(true));
  // ObjectDef destructor fires: RegisterAutoInit(type_index_)
});

// Python usage (via __ffi_init__):
# n = MyNode(42, tag="hello")   # value=42, tag="hello", cache_key=-1 (from default)
# RecursiveEq(n1, n2) ignores cache_key; RecursiveHash(n1) ignores cache_key
```

### RecursiveEq cycle safety
**Context**: From `tests/python/test_structural.py` — structurally equivalent cyclic objects.

```python
import tvm_ffi, tvm_ffi.testing
_recursive_eq = tvm_ffi.get_global_func("ffi.RecursiveEq")

def make_cyclic(v_i64):
    obj = tvm_ffi.testing.create_object("testing.TestObjectDerived",
        v_i64=v_i64, v_f64=0.0, v_str="x",
        v_map=tvm_ffi.Map({}), v_array=tvm_ffi.Array([]))
    obj.v_array = tvm_ffi.Array([obj])  # self-referencing cycle
    return obj

a, b = make_cyclic(42), make_cyclic(42)
assert _recursive_eq(a, b)   # structurally equal cycles
assert not _recursive_eq(a, make_cyclic(99))
```
